meta.title: Become a member | Bitcoin Torino
meta.description: How to join Associazione Ricreativa Culturale Bitcoin Torino: what membership involves, the application steps and the association's details.

hero.title: Become a member
hero.subtitle: We bring together the Bitcoin ecosystem of Turin and connect it with businesses and institutions. Members support the association's activities and set its direction in the general assembly.

pillars.title: What we do
pillars.description: Four activities set out in our statute and carried out by the members.

membership.title: What membership involves
membership.description: Rights and commitments are those of the statute, approved at the founding meeting on 13 March 2026.

vote.title: Vote in the assembly
vote.description: Every member takes part in the General Assembly with voting rights, elects the Board of Directors and can be elected to it.

projects.title: Contribution to projects
projects.description: Events and education, support for merchants accepting bitcoin, relations with businesses and institutions. Each member chooses where to contribute.

fee.title: Annual membership fee
fee.description: The amount is set each year by the Board of Directors and communicated during the application. It covers the current financial year, from 1 January to 31 December.

transparency.title: Non-profit by statute
transparency.description: All offices are unpaid, with reimbursement of documented expenses only. Surpluses are never distributed: they stay with the association's activities.

steps.title: How to join
steps.description: Four steps, from the first meetup to the members' register.

items.title: Come to an event
items.description: Membership starts with getting to know each other. Most events are free and open to everyone, and the calendar is published on Luma.

items.title: Fill in the membership application
items.description: The form collects the details needed for the members' register and your acceptance of the statute.

items.title: Wait for the Board's decision
items.description: The Board of Directors reviews the application and communicates the outcome by email.

items.title: Pay the fee and join the members' channels
items.description: Membership is active for the current financial year once the fee is paid. The confirmation includes access instructions for the internal channels and the assembly.

steps.note: Companies, associations and public bodies follow a different route: write to us and we will work out the right form of collaboration.

facts.title: The association in brief
facts.description: The details worth knowing before you apply.

before.title: Before you apply
before.description: You do not need to be a member to take part. Events and community channels are open to everyone.

cta.title: Send your application
cta.description: The Board of Directors reviews applications and replies by email. If you have questions about requirements or the fee, write to us first.
